final_counterfactual.wrong_acceptance: final after-program loss > before-program loss + minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.wrong_rejection: final rejected-program loss < restored-program loss - minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.denominators: scored revise and rollback events respectively; missing AST records remain separate
final_counterfactual.scope: only alternatives actually involved in recorded decisions; final labels never enter learning

limitations: Development and earlier confirmation outcomes informed v3 development; they are retrospective comparisons.
Forward is a public synthetic prospective partition; its generator is visible and not held by an independent custodian.
v3 changes both experiment/selection policy and the available startup expression language; ablations separate these contributions.
Three suite seeds produce coarse bootstrap intervals; failures and unknown costs remain explicit.
Only the first seed retains up to three v2 and three v3 case traces, selected after evaluation by prediction and risk loss.
Compute units and learning wall time remain separate; final counterfactual evaluation has its own cost and never updates learning.

design.pairing: same suite seed, initial and catalog probes, final evaluation and budget caps; adaptive queries may differ
design.expression_language: v3 adds learned startup branches with history availability; without_warm_start removes that option
design.specific_deletion: first actually learned acquisition concept and its recorded derivatives, before first transfer
design.reference_forward_adapter: saved v2 config uses confirmation label; experiment injects the live forward environment generator

inference.quality_and_costs: reported separately; no conversion of prediction loss into compute units

final_counterfactual.wrong_acceptance: final after-program loss > before-program loss + minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.wrong_rejection: final rejected-program loss < restored-program loss - minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.denominators: scored revise and rollback events respectively; missing AST records remain separate
final_counterfactual.scope: only alternatives actually involved in recorded decisions; final labels never enter learning

limitations: Development and earlier confirmation outcomes informed v3 development; they are retrospective comparisons.
Forward is a public synthetic prospective partition; its generator is visible and not held by an independent custodian.
v3 changes both experiment/selection policy and the available startup expression language; ablations separate these contributions.
Three suite seeds produce coarse bootstrap intervals; failures and unknown costs remain explicit.
Only the first seed retains up to three v2 and three v3 case traces, selected after evaluation by prediction and risk loss.
Compute units and learning wall time remain separate; final counterfactual evaluation has its own cost and never updates learning.

design.pairing: same suite seed, initial and catalog probes, final evaluation and budget caps; adaptive queries may differ
design.expression_language: v3 adds learned startup branches with history availability; without_warm_start removes that option
design.specific_deletion: first actually learned acquisition concept and its recorded derivatives, before first transfer
design.reference_forward_adapter: saved v2 config uses confirmation label; experiment injects the live forward environment generator
